name: description-list
description: Styled description list (dl/dt/dd) for longer descriptive key-value content

changes.note: Nested components keep their own parts. The term and details rules were descendant selectors, so a list nested in a <dd> took the outer list's size and dividers, and so would any component with a term or details part. They now match a direct child of the list, or a child of a plain <div> grouping one pair (dl > div > dt + dd, which HTML allows); the <div> hop is in :where(), so both shapes keep the old specificity. Also documented on the details slot: data-size="sm" maps to --text-xs by the registry-wide convention for components whose md is --text-sm, so a nested text should omit data-size to inherit the list's size.

The horizontal variant's details track is minmax(0, 1fr) instead of 1fr. A bare 1fr cannot be narrower than its widest item's min-content, so details holding a scrolling block or a wide table widened the list past its container. The term track keeps its minmax(8rem, auto) floor.

details.description: The description or value (dd element). A nested text should omit data-size so it inherits the list's size

divided.description: Show divider lines between items (data-divided attribute)

required_attrs: Uses semantic dl/dt/dd elements for screen reader support
